description: This file defines React components for a user prompt modal interface within a settings context. It includes components for editing prompts, managing prompt state, searching, and interacting with prompt data.

classes.name: EditPromptModal
classes.description: A React component for editing individual prompts, allowing modifications to title and content, and closing the modal.

methods.name: UserPromptModal
methods.description: Main React component rendering a modal for managing user prompts, including search, add, edit, and copy functionalities.
